title: Room 201
caption: Noir cool jazz instrumental with vibraphone. Shimmering vibraphone lead with slow motor tremolo, walking upright bass, brushed snare and soft ride cymbal, hollow-body jazz guitar playing quiet chords, a brief bass solo. Suspenseful, smoky, a private eye's office at night. Warm vintage analog sound. No vocals.
note: Preferred in the listening test (configuration C).
